text: Android: a full resync wipes offline edits beyond the pushed batch and every quarantined row

Landed in 74b1a9e. Instead of wiping and re-inserting, the 410 path now deletes only rows the server can reproduce (dirty = 0 AND syncBlocked = 0) in one transaction, so the backlog past the 250 cap and every quarantined row with its reason survive and are reconciled by the cursor-0 pull on the ordinary LWW clocks. Consequence noted: the post-410 retry is no longer a pure pull, bounded by the existing progress guard. Three tests, mutation-checked.
